description: A5b K=2 extended beta-sweep on A2.5 anchor. K=2 = (A2 + G4_gi + G_other) for G_other in {G1_voicing, G5_modulation, G6_spectral} with the same extended beta grid {0..2, 2.5..16} jointly with tau on train_threshold. Per-seed argmax beta* lock; admit if K=2 mean UAR exceeds K=1 LOCKED + 0.005 (~1 sigma above K=1 reference 0.6913).
